mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months (FEDFUNDS) signals an easing monetary policy, which reduces the discount rate for equity valuation and increases the present value of future cash flows, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances when the 3-month change in FEDFUNDS is negative, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5%, it indicates a restrictive monetary policy that is likely to be reversed in the near term, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the market anticipates a rate cut.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) and decline in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals an imminent recession, which triggers a flight to safety and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises > 0.3pp and PAYEMS falls > 100k in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.3pp and PAYEMS falls > 100k in 1 month, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime (as indicated by HOUST > 1500 and RSAFS > 700000), strong demand for housing and consumer spending signals an overheating economy, which triggers central bank tightening and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when HOUST > 1500 and RSAFS > 700000, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) over the past 3 months signals a weakening economy, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when the 3-month change in INDPRO is negative, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the annualized inflation rate (computed from CPIAUCSL) exceeds 3.5%, it signals persistent inflation, leading to aggressive monetary tightening and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL annualized inflation > 3.5%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months (FEDFUNDS) signals an easing monetary policy, which reduces the discount rate for equity valuation and increases the present value of future cash flows, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of instances when the 3-month change in FEDFUNDS is negative, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) signals a weakening economy, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of instances when the quarterly change in GDPC1 is negative, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
